title: Zesty Dense Turkish Bulgur Kisir
description: A traditional Turkish dish made with bulgur, featuring a dense and bitter flavor profile, cooked in a tagine and served on a cedar plank, this recipe is jain-friendly and perfect for festive occasions.
instructions: Rinse the bulgur in cold water and drain well.
In a large tagine or heavy pot, combine the bulgur, chicken stock cubes, onion, tomato paste, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add 2 cups of water to the tagine and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the bulgur is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the kisir to a cedar plank or a serving platter.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
